modelsFrom: installed pi-ai chat catalog (tool calling only)

providers.label: Anthropic
providers.note: API key, existing bearer/OAuth token, or workload identity environment settings. Setup does not log in or refresh OAuth tokens.

providers.label: Ollama (models on your machine)

settings.name: OLLAMA_API_KEY
settings.description: Optional credential for an authenticated proxy

providers.note: Install/start Ollama and pull a tool-capable model first. Type its exact model id (including tags). Uses the OpenAI-compatible /v1 API, not Ollama's native chat API; no key required locally. Custom models use conservative text-only, non-reasoning metadata, 32768 context and 4096 output tokens; actual server/model limits may be lower.

providers.label: Amazon Bedrock
providers.note: Bearer token, AWS profile, access key pair, ECS task role, or web identity. Configure AWS_REGION/AWS_DEFAULT_REGION if needed; catalog region defaults otherwise apply. Setup does not create cloud credentials.

providers.label: Azure
providers.note: Set AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY and AZURE_OPENAI_BASE_URL or AZURE_OPENAI_RESOURCE_NAME. Models may be Azure deployment names. Uses native Responses/Completions catalog APIs; legacy deployment URLs are not supported.

providers.label: GitHub Copilot
providers.note: Requires an existing COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN; enable the desired model in Copilot. Setup does not perform subscription login.

providers.label: Google Vertex AI
providers.note: Google Cloud API key, or project/location plus ADC: run gcloud auth application-default login or set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS to a service-account file. No key is needed with ADC.

providers.label: MiniMax
providers.note: Global endpoint; minimax-cn is the separate China endpoint.

providers.label: Z.AI
providers.note: Z.ai Coding Plan global endpoint, not the general API billing endpoint.
